name: Daggerspine Scale
summary: Along Hillsbrad Foothills’ southern shore, prowling Daggerspine naga yield tough reptilian scales sought by the Royal Apothecary Society. The scales help activate virulent brews in the Forsaken’s ongoing plague experiments.

sections.title: Apothecary Research
sections.body:
The Royal Apothecary Society seeks reagents for its toxins, plagues, and concoctions. While refining the experimental Elixir of Agony, its apothecaries found that Daggerspine naga scales react in a useful way. Combined with troll regenerative elixirs and murloc organs, the scales chemically activate dormant contaminating agents suspended in raw mixtures.

To gather the scales, you must hunt along the rocky coastline east of Southshore. The vicious naga tribe and Alliance forces are both nearby. The apothecaries need the scales for their research.

faq.q: What are Daggerspine Scales used for?
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill gathers Daggerspine Scales for research into the Elixir of Agony. Combined with other reagents, they activate the contaminating properties of an alchemical mudsnout mixture.

faq.q: Where do these scales come from?
faq.answer: Daggerspine Scales come from Daggerspine naga along the Hillsbrad Foothills coastline directly east of Southshore. Shorestalkers, shorehunters, screamers, sirens, and their leader, Lady Zephris, all provide them.

faq.q: Why does the Royal Apothecary Society want naga scales?
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society wants Daggerspine Scales because their resilient scales have the chemical properties needed to trigger specific infectious agents in experimental blight and disease concoctions.

angles.text: As an Undead, you help the Royal Apothecary Society research devastating new plagues against the Forsaken’s enemies.
As a member of the Horde, you must move carefully along the southern shore. Daggerspine encampments lie dangerously close to the Alliance port of Southshore.
